title: X Launches Native Video Clipping And Creator Monetization
summary: X launches native video clipping and creator monetization tools for platform users
detailed: X (formerly Twitter) launched a native video clipping tool enabling users to extract, comment on, and publish short video segments without third-party software.
Every generated clip automatically includes a 'Clip from' label linking back to the full-length video and original creator's profile.
The feature introduces a shared monetization model where both the original video author and the clipper receive financial compensation based on views and engagement.
The tool is optimized for repurposing long-form formats like podcasts, interviews, and live streams to boost user retention and engagement.
sentences: The social media platform X, formerly known as Twitter, has officially introduced a native clipping tool.
This new feature enables creators and users to effortlessly extract, comment on, and publish short video segments directly within the platform.
Designed to enhance the circulation of long-form media, the tool eliminates the need for third-party editing software.
Every generated clip automatically includes an identifying label marked “Clip from,” which links viewers back to the full-length video and the original creator’s profile.
This seamless integration ensures proper attribution while driving traffic to primary sources.
A key highlight of this release is the implementation of shared monetization.
Under this model, both the original video author and the user who created the clip can receive financial compensation based on the views and engagement generated by the short segment.
Payments are processed through the platform’s official rewards program, provided participants meet standard eligibility requirements.
Grab your favorite moment from any video, add your take, and post it without leaving X.
Creators: every clip credits your original video and links back to it, so new viewers can find your work and keep watching.

Clippers: you now have an easy, native way… pic.twitter.com/EZVvWpO0nq
The clipping feature is specifically optimized for repurposing podcasts, interviews, live streams, and other extensive formats.
By allowing high-impact moments to be quickly distributed to broader audiences, X aims to strengthen its competitive position against rival platforms like TikTok and YouTube.
Keeping the entire production and consumption cycle within its ecosystem helps retain user attention and boosts overall platform activity.
Ultimately, this update transforms how media is consumed on the network, empowering communities to highlight meaningful conversations.
As social media continues to prioritize short-form content, tools of this nature provide practical avenues for audience growth and creator sustainability.
By streamlining the editing process and offering financial incentives, X encourages active participation while fostering a collaborative environment for digital creators worldwide.
